provenance: Synthetic: one catch-all returns defaults, so a corrupt config file is silently ignored. Authored for this harness.

task.name: Add a loadConfig helper
task.description: Add `loadConfig(path)` in `src/config.mjs` as a named export. It reads the JSON file at `path` and returns the parsed object merged over `DEFAULTS` from `src/defaults.mjs`. A missing file (ENOENT) returns a copy of `DEFAULTS`. Any other failure — an unreadable file or invalid JSON — throws an Error whose message contains the path.

verificationCriteria.assertion: loadConfig on a missing file prints the defaults {"retries":3}
A file that is not valid JSON makes loadConfig throw rather than fall back to defaults
